traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Feelings meet imagination and dissolution. A need for escape and reverie, high sensitivity, and compassion. The trine makes this a natural strength: Imaginative and receptive; help seems to arrive from others. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Feeling and imagination flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what feeling and imagination have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Strong for imaginative work; protect boundaries and energy.
shadow: The ease lets moodiness and over-need and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.
